items.summary_en: On Aotea Great Barrier Island in New Zealand, a Maori-led project has driven the wild cat population down from about 2,500 to fewer than 15 in the north. The trapping work has also given islanders jobs and a reason to come home. The team runs free microchipping and sterilising for pet cats, plus a cat taxi to the vet.

items.title_en: Aotea Island Comes Back to Life After Cats Are Cleared
